introduction: Video excerpt from the Israeli-Palestinian conflict

vocabulary.definition: a formal and organized process of electing or being elected, especially of members of a political body.
vocabulary.example: The presidential elections will take place next month.

vocabulary.definition: a person who uses unlawful violence and intimidation, especially against civilians, in the pursuit of political aims.
vocabulary.example: The group was labeled as a terrorist organization by the government.

vocabulary.definition: an act or means of sealing off a place to prevent goods or people from entering or leaving.
vocabulary.example: The blockade caused shortages of essential supplies in the region.

vocabulary.definition: the action of harming someone because they have harmed oneself; revenge.
vocabulary.example: The airstrikes were in retaliation for the earlier attacks.

vocabulary.definition: enter (a place, situation, or sphere of activity) in large numbers, especially with intrusive effect.
vocabulary.example: The army invades the enemy territory under cover of darkness.

vocabulary.definition: a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.
vocabulary.example: The conflict arose due to differences in political ideologies.
